findings.text: issue (blocking): run_once passes the prompt as the positional value after -p; every real contract starts with YAML frontmatter `---`, which claude's option parser rejects as an unknown option before any network call (reproduced directly against the real binary). The tool cannot obtain a real cold-read answer against either real contract.
findings.fix: deliver the prompt in a form that cannot be parsed as an option (stdin), add a regression test whose prompt begins with ---, re-verify with a real --runs 2 call before any baseline

findings.text: issue: the claude -p invocation carries no grounding citation for how the positional prompt is parsed; the assumption is wrong for content starting with ---
findings.fix: grounding comment near run_once citing the exact claude --help behaviour relied on, plus a test at the parser boundary

findings.text: issue: a non-zero claude return code is folded into the body and recorded status ok, identical to a real answer — the mechanism that hid the fatal bug from summary.json
findings.fix: record the returncode; status ok only when 0, else error; surface it in summary.json runs[]

findings.text: issue: --out naming an existing file and a missing --contract path crash uncaught instead of the module's error/exit-2 convention

findings.text: issue: n_items = len(items) silently scores a non-contiguous fixture's highest item as always wrong

findings.text: issue (blocking): passing the inline prompt directly after -p makes both real contracts fail because their leading --- is parsed as an option, so the runner produces no attribution measurements
findings.fix: use a supported stdin/end-of-options form that preserves the prompt verbatim; add a subprocess-facing regression test with a frontmatter contract

findings.text: issue (blocking): every non-zero claude exit is assigned status ok; auth or CLI failures can be scored as evidence and drive the wave-2 wording decision
findings.fix: persist the return code, mark non-zero as error, exclude failed invocations from conclusions or fail the batch

findings.text: issue (blocking): --resume accepts any existing run file without verifying contract, fixture, model, prompt hash or N, then writes a summary carrying the current inputs' hashes; stale transcripts can be attributed to a different experiment
findings.fix: validate every resumed header against the current hashes, model, prompt hash and N; reject mismatches with exit 2; regression tests

findings.text: issue (blocking): the external claude CLI surface is used without a grounding citation for the positional prompt, --model, --output-format, or the asserted lack of a seed flag
findings.fix: checked-in captured help evidence or a maintained citation supporting the exact invocation and the no-seed claim

findings.text: issue: the checkpoint's probes array is empty, so the adversary probes this round relies on are not inspectable
